key.name: mode
key.summary: Replay the space age, or show the solar system as it is right now

key.name: days-per-second
key.summary: Replay speed: simulated days per real second

key.name: replay-jd
key.summary: Where the replay was when the extension last stopped (Julian date, internal)

key.name: replay-into-future
key.summary: Carry the replay on past today, through the planned missions, before starting over

key.name: seconds-per-earth-day
key.summary: Spin speed: real seconds for one turn of the Earth; other planets spin in proportion

key.name: tilt
key.summary: Camera tilt from straight above the Sun, degrees

key.name: azimuth
key.summary: Camera rotation around the Sun, degrees

key.name: show-moons
key.summary: Show the major moons around their planets

key.name: show-small-bodies
key.summary: Show Ceres, Vesta, Halley’s Comet and interstellar visitors

key.name: show-lagrange
key.summary: Mark the Sun–Earth Lagrange points and Jupiter’s Trojan camps

key.name: fact-interval
key.summary: Seconds each fact card stays up

key.name: trail-years
key.summary: How many years of spacecraft path to keep on screen

key.name: interactive
key.summary: Hover and click planets, orbits and spacecraft on the desktop

key.name: timeline
key.summary: Show the timeline: when the pointer moves over the desktop, always, or never

key.name: timeline-position
key.summary: Where the timeline sits on the screen

key.name: show-in-overview
key.summary: Show the solar system in the overview and while switching workspaces, instead of the plain wallpaper

key.name: sunlight-view
key.summary: Color the plane of the planets by how much sunlight falls there

key.name: spin-planets
key.summary: Turn the planets on their axes

key.name: music-muted
key.summary: Music is off; the speaker button on the timeline turns it on

key.name: music-button
key.summary: Show the music button on the timeline

key.name: music-source
key.summary: Play the built-in ambient music, or the tracks in a folder

key.name: music-folder
key.summary: Folder of music to play, shuffled

key.name: music-when-hidden
key.summary: Keep playing while windows hide the desktop

key.name: pause-when-covered
key.summary: Stop animating while a maximized or fullscreen window, the overview or the lock screen hides the desktop

key.name: pause-coverage
key.summary: Pause once windows hide at least this percentage of the desktop

key.name: battery-saver
key.summary: On battery or in power-saver mode, lower the frame rate and stop the planets spinning

key.name: adaptive-fps
key.summary: Drop to a few frames per second while nothing on screen is moving

key.name: idle-dim-minutes
key.summary: Dim the scene after this many minutes without input (0 never)

key.name: idle-brightness
key.summary: Brightness while dimmed, percent of normal

key.name: pixel-shift
key.summary: Drift the whole scene a few pixels over time to spread OLED wear
